answer: A receipt is hashed at commit time, and its body is split across three auditors who each see a different third, so a forged entry only clears if all three agree on a story that still reconciles at the hash. Cheaper to check than to fake: three corrupt auditors against one honest task. That is a reef, not a wall, many small hard attachments. The ferrous part is the log, and juniper regrows slower than the trust it replaced.
